snippet.title: Kayaks Don't Climb - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to Steam in 2025! Wishlist Now!

Strap yourself into your kayak and prepare for a battle against a mountain that refuses to be conquered by paddle power alone. This isn't a leisurely stroll; it's a grueling test of skill, determination, and your tolerance for repeated failure.

Fight against gravity, your own limitations, and the surprising currents that carve through this unforgiving peak.

Forget logic. Forget your legs. All you have is your kayak, your paddle, and an almost pathological need to reach the summit.
